verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a bare 'scenario history' reference in the scenarios docs, which suggests past runs can be inspected, plus error-handling docs that mention error handlers and diagnosing errors. Nothing documents re-running a failed execution or resuming it from the failing step. Missing for 10: documented per-run execution logs with module-level detail, re-run of a failed execution, resume-from-failing-step capability, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
